test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given

statements.

Statements:

No statue is a book.

No book is a copy.

Conclusions:

(I) No copy is a statue.

(II) Some books are statues.
solution:
Statements:

No statue is a book.

No book is a copy.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6c6ec1658006d47ddd9e65f657c9fb323baa9c2d50be3479cd37604a03c32f4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbd85ec4abd5359ab95a2a0e0d1ec331532fa6da06ea9a8826565f847ed384fe.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No copy is a statue. → **Not F**ollow (There is no direct relation between copy and statue.)

(II) Some books are statues.. → Not Follow (As No statue is a book then Some books are statues is not possible.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
